comment: Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy (grade 5). Density 4.43 g/cm3: Wikipedia 'Ti-6Al-4V' (4.429 to 4.512 g/cm3). Hardness 336 HB: the typical 36 HRC that page gives, converted with the ASTM E140 tables. kc1.1 1500 N/mm2: approximate, ISO 513 group S (titanium alloys). Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: Ti-6Al-4V (annealed)
